_comment: Interim catalogue for the Vanrycke AR pilot. ar-tryon.html reads /api/products/{handle}/ar-config first and falls back to this file until the jewelry_models table + route ship (plan day 5). Dimensions in mm, GLBs in metres. `variants` maps the gold colour option to a GLB; ar-tryon.html picks by ?color=, default rose. Only the necklace exists in white gold (Revan, 2026-11-15); ring and earring are rose only. Model URLs carry ?v=N: bump N whenever a GLB is rebuilt, or phones keep drawing the cached old one (happened on 2026-11-15).
